tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po'i rdzogs rim skor gyi zab khrid bzhugs so//

dpag yas rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum// gcig gyur sin+dhu'i mtsho gling pad+ma'i dbus// gsang chen theg pa'i 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku// yon tan bsam mi khyab der gus phyag 'tshal// theg gsum lam rim rgya mtsho'i 'jing rum nas// tshe 'dir grub gnyis dbang bsgyur nor bu gang*// nges par blangs nas kun rtog sgrib pa'i tshogs// 'phrog byed mgon po snying gi pad+mor bzhugs// 'di na mchog gi zhal lung gu ru yi// dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po'i rdzogs rim skor// gang gi drin gyis legs par 'chad byed na// gnang ba stsal zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de yang bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i snying po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhes chos thams cad bskyed rdzogs gnyis su bsdus nas/ rgyud las sgrub thabs su bsdus/ sgrub thabs man ngag tu bsdus/ man ngag lag len du bstan te/ byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma bsgrub pa'i man ngag yang gsang dngos grub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i zab chos 'di nyid kyi gzhung las/ yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs srog phur bcas: mthar thug lta sgom spyod 'bras khrid rim dang : gtum mo 'pho ba rdzas dang dmigs pa ni: skal ldan tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub phyir gsungs: zhes ḍā ki ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis them byang 'god par mdzad pa'i sprul sku lam du byed pa sku rdo rje ma hā yo ga dang rjes su 'brel ba rdzogs dang rdzogs chen gyi brdar bzhag pa'i a nu yo ga'i nyams len sogs bum dbang 'brel ba bskyed rim lha khrid phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid sgrub las kha tshar phrin las bzhi dang mtha' rgyas tshe sgrub sogs kyi skor rnams kaḥthog pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus gter ston chen po las 'phro gling pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang mjal nas rjes su gnang bas khrid yig zhib rgyas su mdzad grub cing*/

rdzogs rim skor la dgongs pa lam lus lta bur yig cha mdzad rgyu ni bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi skal bas ma byung snang yang*/ gter chen rin po che nas rig 'dzin gter ston kho nar brgyud pa'i bka' srol khyad par 'phags pa nyid skyabs mgon tshe dbang nor bu mchog gis 'brug chen bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta la gnang ba'i gter gzhung gi khrid lung dang*/ smin byed zab mo mchog tu gyur pa'i byin rlabs 'pho ba'i rim pa rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po'i bka' drin las thob pa nyid gtso bor byas te rdzogs rim gyi khrid tshul lhag pa'i blo yis ji ltar nus bzhin 'chad pa la/ gtum mo/ 'pho ba/ ka dag /thod rgal gyi khrid dang bzhi ste/ de'ang rim pa bzhi'i 'gros dang bstun nas mtshan bcas mtshan med dam rdzogs dang rdzogs chen gyi khrid sngon du 'chad cing*/ 'pho ba dang bar do zhar byung lam gyi yan lag tu 'chad na gzhung gzhan dang mthun zhing 'jug pa bde bas/ de la longs sku lam du byed pa gsung rdo rje a nu yo ga ltar rdzogs rim thabs lam tsaṇ+ḍa li'i khrid la/ gnas grogs dus dang yo byad la sogs gsang sngags spyi ltar mthun rkyen tshogs par bsags/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs/ bskyed rim brtan por bsgrub cing lha khrid las ji ltar bshad pa'i dus rtags grangs kyi bsnyen pa tshad du bskyal/ rdzogs rim la 'jug pa'i sngon dang thun bar sogs su bla ma yi dam gyi tshogs bskang ba bdag 'jug la sogs nan du blangs/ ḍā ki dang chos skyong gter bdag gtor mchod kyis mnyes par byas nas/ dngos gzhi la/ gzhung las/ gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar la: stong ra 'od kyi sku can bsgom: pho mo ma ning rlung ro 'don: lus gnad bcas shing lte 'og bzung: zhes gsungs pas/ stan bde ba la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun du grags pa spyi 'gro ltar bcas/ rlung ro lan gsum dor ba khog par cung zad re skyil nas mthar rlung shugs shin tu chung ba mi 'don pa'i tshul du 'bud pa mnyam pa ste ma ning dang*/

de las cung zad drag pa 'jam ring mo rlung dang*/ mthar thung zhing 'bud ba sgra can pho rlung gi rnam pa sir sgra dang bcas lhag med du 'bud/ lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mi mthun phyogs rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa thams cad snod bkru bshal byas pa bzhin ro rkyang gi lam nas rlung gi rnam par lhag med du thon par bsam/ de nas stong ra'am rang byin gyis brlab pa zhes rang lus pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi sku snang stong chu zla lta bu/ rnam pa sngar bskyed rim gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba nang thams cad stong sang nge ba phru ma phus btab pa lta bur bsgom mo// stong ra la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa gtad na 'di skabs nas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags snang re gnyis 'char bar sngags gsar ma'i chos drug las bshad pas de lta bu'i brtson 'grus drag pos bsgom/ de nas rtsa sbyang ba ni/ sku'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po/ sbom phra mda' smyug tsam yar sna tshangs bug tu zug cing*/ mar sna lte 'og sum mdor yod pa gnyis ka kha bye ba/ g.yas ro ma dmar po/ g.yon rkyang ma dkar po gnyis tshangs bug nas mdun du 'khyogs te yar sne sna bug gnyis su yod pa/ mar sna yi ge cha'i 'phang lta bur bkug nas dbu ma'i nang du chud pa sbom phra gro sog tsam pa/ gsum ka'ang nang stong pa sum mdor ro rkyang gi sne dbu ma'i nang du nyi gdan reg bya tsha zhing bsreg pa can gyi dbus su a shad me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ yi ge gzab kyi shad lta bu la/ rtsa ba cung zad phra nyams can/ rtse mo shin tu phra zhing sum 'khyog gi rnam par gsal nan gyis gdab bo// spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du dbu ma las yal ga phyogs bzhi dang de las kyang phyogs mtshams su gyes pa'i rnam pas spyi bor rtse mo rnam par bkod pa'i 'khor lo kha dog sngon po rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa/ mgrin par ro 'dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa kha dog ser po/

snying gar dran 'dzin gyi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po rtsa 'dab brgyad pa/ lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo kha dog ljang gu rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi/ spyi 'khor gyi dbus su dbu mar zla gdan sran ma phyed gshag tsam thur gyu'i ngos su haṃ yig mgo thur bstan du bsgom/ de nas rlung sbyang ba ni/ sna sgo nas rlung dal gyis rngub la lte 'og tu mer gyis dgang*/ srin zhal bskum/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then/ slar yang mnan nas kha sbyor du bzung*/ dmigs pa steng rlung ro rkyang gi lam brgyud/ 'og rlung dang lhan cig phog pas a shad kyi me de dmar lam gyis song bar bsam/ rlung sems de kho na la drag tu gtad/ mi thub na rngub chung brtsegs/ g.yas g.yon dbus nas gzhil/ slar yang mi thub pa na seng sgra dang bcas lhag med du sna nas 'bud/ dmigs pa rlung sngo dwangs kyi rnam pa mda' gang tsam du song bar bsams nas phyi 'dzin cung zad bya/ de lta bu bskyar zhing ma brtan gyi bar du bsgom/ me dmigs chung ba 'dis drod kyi yon tan ma skyes par 'bar 'dzag sngas na gegs su 'gyu ra bas shin tu goms pa gal che/ de la goms pa dang steng 'og gi rlung phog pa'i rkyen gyis gtum mo'i me sor phyed tsam 'bar/ de nas kyang rlung gi gnad sngar ltar la rlung khug ji ltar rigs pas thog mar lte 'khor gyi rtse tshun/ de nas snying ga /de nas mgrin pa dang lag sor gyi rtse tshun/ de nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo yongs rdzogs kyi bar gtum mo'i mes gang bar bsam/ de nas mthar spyi bo'i haṃ yig la reg pas bde ba'i nyams skyes te chil chil khol bar bsgom/ de nas drod kyi nus pas bde ba tshad du pheb par bya phyir thig le sbyang ba ni/ gtum mo'i mes spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu nas byang sems thig le bcu drug 'dzag pas spyi bo'i 'khor lo yongs rdzogs khengs pas dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ lus gnad dang rlung gi gnad sngar dang 'dra zhing rlung khug pa ji ltar rigs pa dang bstun/

thig le de'i phyed kyi cha ste brgyad mgrin par babs nas rtsa 'dab thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes skyes/ de'i phyed kyi cha ste bzhi snying gar babs/ rtsa 'dab thams cad gang nas dga' bral gyi ye shes skyes/ de'i phyed kyi cha gnyis lte bar babs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab thams cad gang*/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su gnas pa'i sprul sku drug gi sa bon dwangs ma'i thig le bcu drug 'bar zhu'i rnam pas lus sems thams cad bde drod dam/ bde stong gis khyab pa'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag /de lta bu'i skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu dang 'bros ded sogs 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa yang yang bsgom zhing*/ thun bar du dkar dmar 'dres pa'i thig les lus kyi ba spu'i mthar thug par gang bar bsam la lus sprugs dang 'phur bsrub drag tu bya/ ha cang bde ba rgyas drags na byang chub kyi sems lugs ldog gi rnam pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong nas spyi bo'i ham̐ yig la bstim/ gtum mo'i me rnams a shad nyid la bstim/ stong ra rtsa 'khor la sogs pa'i rnam pa yang dmigs med spros bral gyi ngang du bsdus nas gnas lugs ka dag gi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag cing bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar gnas pa rtsa la dmigs pa gtad tsam nas stong ra rtsa 'khor bcas gsal thebs pa/ g.yo ba rlung la bum chen 'byongs tshad gsar rnying gi gzhung gzhan dang mthun zhing drod kyis ras rkyang thub pa/ brtan pa byang chub kyi sems la dran tsam nas lus sems bde phril gyis 'gro thub pa'i bar du sbyang bar bya dgos shing*/ de lta ma yin pa'i thos tsam dang bsgom tsam gyis ni dgos don mi 'grub pas na shin tu goms shing 'dris par sbyang ba dang*/ rdzas sngags dmigs pa zas dang spyod lam sogs kyis spang blang ma nor bas rgyu'i thig le ma nyams par bsrungs nas/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po la nyams len byas pas las rlung ye shes kyi rlung du dag

/rtsa mdud grol zhing phung po lnga dang dug lnga'i sa bon spangs te mchog thun mong gi yon tan thams cad me tog rlan gyis bran pa ltar 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /rang lus thabs ldan la brtan pa thob nas gzhan lus sbyang thabs 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i chos skor yang rdzogs chen gzhan dang mthun no// zhes gsungs pas/ gsang sngags spyi ltar dbang gsum pa dang 'brel ba pho nya'i lam la 'jug par spro na/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gros rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan ldan gyi rig ma la brten nas bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams len te/ de'ang rlung las su rung ba'i rtags thob pa dang*/ khyad par bskyed rim brtan pos tha mal gyi snang ba 'gog nus shing ṭā ki bdud babs kyi gol sa ru mi lhung nges pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i spyod yul las gzhan gyis mi rung bas/ de lta bu'i gnad shes shing drod tshad ldan na khrid tshul dngos rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon pa nyid kyi zab gter thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi chos skor dang*/ tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje sogs su bzhugs kyang brgyud pa 'di la phyag len khrid rgyun nyams bzhes kyi srol ni med de/ u rgyan rin po ches/ dug gi lto yong ba rma bya las med/ dpe de bzhin du lam 'di'ang rnal 'byor pa dbang pa yang rab kyi spyod yul yin zhes gsungs pas na rlung sbyor gyis thig le 'chings nus pa tsam kho nas sngags la kha g.yar ba'i sbyor sgrol du rlom pa'i dug lnga 'jol nyog tu spyad nas rgyal bstan la rma 'byin cing rang nyid mngal gyi srin bu sogs ngan song mi bzad par skye ba'i las mi bsags par snying nas gdams so// gzhan yang gegs sel bogs 'don gyi rigs rdzogs chen gter ma tshad ldan gyi gzhung gang la bstun kyang 'gal ba med cing*/ dbang po tha ma'i don du rdzas kyi gtum mo gsungs mod kyang*/ chos zab mo 'di lta bu la bla ma'i man ngag gis zin pa'i gang zag gis dad brtson drag pos nyams su blangs na de 'dra la ltos pa 'cha' mi dgos pas na 'dir ma bkod la/

dus kun tu me dmigs mi brjed par mnyam bzhag sems 'dzin gyi rten du bya ste des ni yon tan 'phral du 'byung zhing gsar ma'i rlung sems gnyis med kyi gnad dang yang mthun/ bde ba la stong pas rgyas 'debs shing bde stong dbyer med rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang don du gnyer bas tshor bde lam du ma slong ba'i gegs dbang du mi shor zhing bde chen lam gyi bogs 'don snying po yin no// dbang po rtul ba'i rigs kyis nyams su len tshe stong ra rtsa dang 'khor lo me dmigs sogs re re la'ang thun dang zhag gi grangs mang por nan gyis bsgom yang shin tu legs pa nyid do// bde stong gtum mo'i nyams len gyi dmigs thun legs par bshad zin to/ ༈ /de nas chos sku lam du byed pa thugs rdo rje a ti yo ga ltar rdzogs chen ka dag khregs chod kyi khrid la/ khrid tshul gzhan ltar na 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba sogs yod kyang gter gzhung dang*/ yang 'grel du de 'dra'i sgros mi 'byung zhing*/ lhag par yang 'grel du 'di ni dbang po yang rab la dgongs pa'i chos go dka' zhing har mchongs lta bu zhig 'dug ste/ 'di la yang dgos pa che ba zhig yod dam snyam/ zhes sogs gsungs phyir 'dir ma spros kyang rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid bka' gzhan dag las gsal bar 'byung ba ji bzhin nyams su len par spro na'ang mi rung ba med cing shin tu legs par sems la/ ma grub kyang chad skyon ni med/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan lag tu len bya ni/ de'ang gtso bo dben pa gsum dang lus gnad la brtson par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dben gsum gyi lus dben chags sdang gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam rtog dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'gro sdod la sogs pa'i bya bzhag mang po'i g.yeng bas nyams len mi 'grub pas/ dben gnas ri khrod lta bur 'dug pa ni phyi'i dben pa dang*/ der yang lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun kho na ma gtogs/

dge sdig lung ma bstan gyi spyod lam gang yang mi bya ba nang gi lus dben/ ngag gi long gtam dang rtsed mo sogs gzhan lta ci smos/ 'don brjod lta bu'i spros pa yang med par rtsol med rang bab kyi rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi ngang du bzhag pa ngag dben/ sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas rtog med bzo bcos bral ba'i ngang du 'jog pa sems dben te/ de lta bus dben gsum la thog mar bslab/ de nas zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ las dang po pas mdun du dmigs rten dhe'u 'am shing bu gang rung zhig bzhag /ri bo cog bzhag lus gnad chos bdun gyi steng nas rgya mtsho cog bzhag mig gis lta stangs dang bcas/ rig pa cog bzhag sems dus gsum kyi spros pa gzhan bcad nas dhe'u hril le ba'am/ shing bu krong nge ba'i rnam pa lam lam pa de kho na la bzo bcos med par rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin/ de nyid brjed nas gzhan du yengs na mi rung bas 'phro bcad nas de kho na la blo bzhag /dhe'u shing bu de nyid la'ang legs nyes dang dbyibs kha dog sogs nang tshan gyi bye brag la dpyad pa'i bsam blo mi btang bar rnam pa spyi ma brjed tsam de la sems gnas pa cung zad ma 'grub kyi bar du nan tan gyis bsgom/ de nas de'i tshab tu yi dam gyi lha'i sku gsung thugs la dmigs rten bcas nas bsgom dgos pa las/ dang po gu ru pad+ma'i sku rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa'am/ yang na rten 'brel dbang gi chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog sngon po rgyan spangs pa phyag mnyam bzhag dang*/ zhabs skyil krung thig le'i dbus su pad zla la bzhugs pa zhig bsgom kyang legs pas/ lha sku gang rung de nyid sngar gyi dhe'u shing bu'i tshab kyi dmigs rten du bya/ lus gnad sems gnad thams cad snga ma ltar byas nas bsgom/ de la goms pa dang lha sku de nyid snying dbus su bsgom nas sems kyi 'jog thabs snga ma ltar bya/

yang lha sku'i tshab tu gsung yig 'bru oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon po sum brtsegs zhig mdun du bsgom/ de la sngar bzhin gnas pa bskyang*/ goms nas spyi bo mgrin pa snying gar yig 'bru gsum bsgom la sems gnad sngar bzhin bya/ yang mdun du yig 'bru'i tshab rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am/ yang na thig le dkar dmar sngo ba gsum brtsegs la sems 'dzin/ gal te thig le la sems 'dzin na 'di dang gong gi 'bru gsum gnyis 'dra ste gcig char du gsal thebs na gsum ka mnyam du bsgom/ ma thebs na re re nas rim pas gsal btab ste bsgom na'ang rung*/ yang goms nas snying gar rdo rje bsgom pa'am/ thig le yin na spyi mgrin snying gar gcig char ram/ rim can gyis dmigs pa gtad nas bsgom/ des rten can la sems 'dzin pa song nas/ rten med la thog mar rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bstan pa ni lus gnad chos bdun thog rlung rang babs kyi 'byung 'jug gnas pa'i rang bzhin nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ dbyung ba hūm̐ du shes pa'i ngang nas rlung dang shes pa mnyam 'grogs kyi tshul du byas nas bsgom mo// de nas rlung ro dor ba sngon du 'gro bas thog mar 'jam rlung dang*/ de nas drag rlung la brten nas sems kyi gnas pa bsgrubs te/ 'di gnyis kyi skabs su sems gnad rtog med kyi ngang du bcas bcos med par 'jog pa yin gyis/ rdor bzlas lta bu'i rlung dang shes pa mnyam 'grogs mi dgos/ thabs de rnams la brten nas lus sog phon thag pa chad pa lta bu/ ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa lta bu/ sems rang 'thag gi chu chad pa lta bu/ de kho na nyid mar me rlung gis mi bskyod pa lta bur ngo 'phrod kyi bar du sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas brtan por bsgrub pa gal che/ de nas lhag mthong ni/ gzhung las/ de nas 'gyu ba dang gnas pa gcig tu song na dbyibs kha dog la sogs rtsad gcod btang ste: bsgom bya sgom byed med par gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma dag par bya'o:

zhes gsungs pas dang po rtog pa rtsad bcad pa ni/ 'khor bar 'khyams shing bde sdug myong mkhan 'di lus ngag yid gsum gang yin brtags pas byed po sems su shes par nges so// bar du mtshang btsal ba ni/ de ltar rtog byed kyi sems dang lus ngag gnyis gcig gam tha dad du 'dug brtags pas/ gcig na sems ngos bzung med pa bzhin lus ngag kyang ngos bzung med par 'gro la/ ngag sgra dang tshig tu yod cing*/ lus reg gzugs su grub pa ltar sems kyang de 'drar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod/ tha dad na dngos po rag pa ltar dbye ba'i rdzas su grub dgos shing*/ gcig tha dad lhan cig ni mi srid par 'gal ba dang*/ de dag gang yang ma yin pa ni mi 'byung ngo zhes de ltar brtags pas da lta lus ngag yid gsum du 'dug go snyam na/ gsum du 'dug go snyam pa sus shes brtags pa na sems des shes so snyam na/ des na bdag gzhan dgra gnyen/ gcig tha dad/ yod med/ yin min thams cad med bzhin du rang gi sems kyi rtog pas bzos pa yin la/ bzos kyang de nyid du ma grub ste thams cad brda tsam/ btags pa tsam las bden par grub pa ci yang med par rtogs pa ni sems kyi mtshang btsal ba'o// tha ma byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags te/ sems 'di dang po gang nas byung*/ bar du gar gnas/ mthar gang du 'gro bar 'dug brtags pas gsum ka'i yul 'di zhes ngos bzung mi rnyed de skye 'gags gnas med rang grol mnyam nyid chen por gtan la phebs par bya'o// de ltar sems tshol gyi dpyad pa sna tshogs pas gtan la phab pas mthar gnas pa dang 'gyu ba so so ma yin par gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du 'char zhing 'gyu ba sems kyi rol par rtogs pas dgag sgrub blang dor med par rang rig rjen pa tshogs drug ma 'gags bzhin du shar ba/ shar bzhin stong pa/ gsal stong dbyer med/ tha dad ma yin pa don gcig tu ma grub pa/ kha nas brjod mi shes pa/ yid la bsam du med pa/

mthong ba'i yul dang bral ba 'di ka la pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes tha snyad tsam du btags pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ sems zhes bya ba yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ dngos po yang ma yin/ dngos med kyang ma yin/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i dbu ma/ ngos bzung dang bral ba'i gsal stong*/ rang bzhin shes pa'i rjen pa hrig ge ba/ lhan ne ba/ 'di zhes brjod pa dang bral ba/ ye rdzogs/ ye shes/ ye dag /bsam brjod med pa 'di kho na sangs rgyas kyi thugs/ sems can gyi sems/ bde sdug myong mkhan thams cad 'di kho na'o zhes ngo sprad/ ces gsungs pa ltar dang*/ dug lnga dang sgo lnga tshogs drug sogs rang grol chos nyid kyi rol par ngo sprad/ khyad par nam mkha' dwangs dus nyi ma la rgyab kyi phyogs nas lta stangs gcun nas bltas pas dpe phyi'i nam mkha' stong mdangs kyi go phyes nas dpe can nang gi shes pa rnam par dag pa las/ gsang ba 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i nam mkha' gsal stong mtha' dbus thams cad las 'das pa'i chos nyid skad cig la 'char ba nam mkha' sum sprugs kyi gdams pa sogs kyis spyod lam kun tu bsre zhing rtsal sbyong ba dang*/ bying rgod kyi skyon bsal te gang shar la spang blang dang re dogs med par rdzogs pa chen po shar grol dus mnyam/ phyi nang dbyer med/ phyogs bcu gcig char/ 'khor gsum yang dag /ye shar ye grol/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang sems can kyi sems dbyer med gnyis su ma grub pa da lta'i shes pa gsal stong rjen pa 'di ka'i thog tu bcas bcos gang yang med par dran tsam rig tsam ma brjed tsam du bskyangs te bzhag thabs rnams su so ma/ lhug pa/ ma bcos pa/ mnyam bzhag sogs ming mang du btags kyang don hril gyis dril na sgom med bsgom pa'i don la skad cig tsam du yang ma yengs par byed pa 'di las dus nam du'ang 'da' ba med do// zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ngo sprod 'di ni nyams len gyi gzhi dang snying po yin pas gnad du khel nges bya dgos te/

de ltar min par thod rgal la 'jug pa sngas kyang dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gnad la reg par mi srid do// 'di dag gi don/ gzhung 'grel du sngon la lta ba ngo sprod de de thog nas bsgom pa btsal ba ni ngo 'phrod dka' ba yin/ 'di ni sngon la sgom pa gtan la dbab nas de thog tu lta ba ngo sprad pas mi 'phrod pa mi srid ces sogs rgya cher gsungs so// des ni a ti yo ga las ka dag gi khrid rgyas par bshad zin to/ ༈ /de nas ngo bo nyid sku lam du byed pa tshig dbang rin po che dang 'brel ba ye shes yang gsang bla med rdo rje snying po ltar lhun grub 'od gsal thod rgal gyi khrid ni/ le'u drug par/ de nas lta sgom spyod gsum yang: zhes pa'i nang tshan thod rgal bsgom na/ lus/ sems/ sgo/ yul/ rlung dang rig pa'i gnad lnga las/ dang po khregs chod la gzhi byas te zhes pa nas/ rang rig rjen pa skye med du gtan la dbab cing thag chod par bya'o// zhes pa'i bar de dang*/ rgya nag sprul sku'i dris lan las/ thod rgal bsgom thabs mang du 'dug kyang nyams len dngos gzhi ni zhes pa'i yig cha gnyis la cung zad brten cing gtso cher zhal rgyun man ngag gzhir bzhag spros te bshad pa ni khregs chod kyi nyams len gong du bshad pa la myong ba thon pa'i gang zag thod rgal la sngar ma zhugs pa las dang po par gyur pa la 'chad cing nyams su len bya/ sprin med pa'i nyi ma dang*/ snga dro dang dgong ka zer gnyis kyi dus sogs mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i skabs/ dben pa'i gnas su lus kyi kun spyod sna tshogs/ phyag bskor/ rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi/ ngag gi 'khrul gtam/ sngags bzlas/ smra brjod/ yid kyi 'khrul rtog /bskyed rim sems 'dzin/ rnam rtog sna tshogs te lus ngag yid kyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang nas dal bar gnas/ lus kyi gnad bzhugs stangs gsum la gnas par bya ste/

de'ang*/ chos sku seng ge'i 'dug stangs/ longs sku glang chen gyi 'dug stangs dang*/ sprul sku drang srong gi 'dug stangs zhes gsungs pas de gsum ka mi dgos kyang*/ gang rung zhig la brten dgos pas/ de yang chos sku'i 'dug stangs ni/ 'phongs sa la bzhag rkang mthil gnyis sprad/ rkang ba'i nang nas lag gnyis khu tshur sa la gtad pa seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang*/ longs sku glang po che'i 'dug stangs ni/ rkang pa gnyis bskum/ byin pa dang brla sbyar/ rkang mthil gshang sgo'i phyogs su 'ong bar byas/ lag pa'i gru mo gnyis pus mo'i mdun du sa la btsug /lag mthil g.yas g.yon gyis mgrin pa'i lkog ma nas gyen du 'degs pa de yin/ sprul sku drang srong gi 'dug stangs ni/ 'phongs sa la bzhag /rkang pa g.yas sems skyil ci lta ba byas/ g.yon pa'i pus mo bslangs/ rkang mthil btsugs nas pus mo g.yon bslangs pa'i steng du lag pa g.yon kha sbub tu bzhag /de'i steng du g.yas kha sbub tu brtsegs/ lus kyi dku g.yon pa brla la cung zad brten pa de'o// sems gnad ni/ lta stangs yul la cung zad gtad cing gzhan rtog med spros bral sngar ka dag skabs kyi lhag mthong de'i ngang du 'jog /sgo yi gnad ni/ mig gi lta stangs ha cang gdang ba dang ha cang btsum pa gnyis ka ma yin par mig lpags phyed btsum gyi rnam pa la/ mig 'bras cung zad gyen du ldog pa'o// de'i dgos khyad rtsa bha san+tu zhes pa'i rten 'brel gyis dbang po sgo lnga'i nang nas mig gi dbang po rang la mngon sum dbyings rig rdo rje lug rgyud 'char ba'i gnad yod par gsungs/ yul gnad ni/ las dang po pas thog mar nyi khrid la bslab pa legs shing*/ de yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dngos la lta stangs gtad na mig la shin tu gnod pa dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ha cang 'gyangs pa yang rtags snang mi 'char ba mang bas de gnyis ka ma yin par/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dngos kyi 'og gi nyi zer mdangs mig la 'char zhing*/

dkyil 'khor dngos mig lpags kyis bsgrib pas mig 'bras kyis cung mi mthong pa'i sa der 'dug stangs gsum po gang rigs kyi thog nas lta stangs gtod de bsgom pa yin/ rlung gnad ni/ rang babs kyi 'byung 'jug gnas gsum shin tu dal zhing 'jam par byed/ de lta bu'i gnad dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas thun chung la grangs mang bar byas nas yun bsrings/ de'i skabs su rig pa'i gnad/ phyi'i dbyings me long dang 'dra bar/ nang gi dbyings sgron ma byad dang 'dra ba 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od lnga'i nang du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma rdzing nang du rdo bor ba'i ri mo ltar snang ba sogs rtags snang 'od mdangs ci ltar shar ba de nyid g.yas g.yon du phar 'gro tshur 'gro 'khyugs pa'i rnam pa byung na yang*/ lta mkhan gyi rig par rang gi ngo bo lta shes tsam las lta stangs sngar gyi der g.yo med du gtad pa yin/ 'dug stangs ni las dang po pas thog ma'i skabs der sngar bshad pa bzhin du byed pa yin la/ phyis nas lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun rang legs/ gzhan rnams rgyun du sngar dang 'dra ba'i steng nas rtags snang lta stangs gtad tsam nas 'char ba byung na sngar gyi sa las cung zad phab ste nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las bar thag cung zad 'gyangs par bya/ de yang rim par rtags snang 'char mi 'char gyi mtshams la rim pas je phab kyi tshul du bya ba yin gyi dang po nas phab ches na rtags snang 'grib pa'i nyan yod cing*/ mthar goms pa na dar seng srab mos mig dkris te nyi ma blta ba seng ras kyi khrid dang*/ shel rdo dang zla 'od sgron me'i 'od la brten pa sogs kyis kyang 'od lnga'i snang ba rtsibs shar gyen 'greng la sogs pa'i rtags snang 'char zhing*/ de la goms pa na mun khang la zhugs te thog mar skar khung la nyi ma'i mdangs shar ba la brten nas rtags snang 'od mdangs ma lus rlung dmigs sngar bshad pa bzhin gyis drangs/ de la goms nas skar khung bkag ste snang ba cung zad med pa'i mun pa nag thing nge pa la bsgom mo// tshul 'di dang*/

de nas nyin mtshan khyad med du nyams su blangs pas zla ba phyed kyis 'byongs par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor sogs sbyor drug dang rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i mun khrid 'od gsal khor yug ces par gsal/ de ltar rgyal mo'i 'od mdangs nyi zer sgron me shel rdo la sogs pa'i zer la brten nas bsgom pas/ dbyings kyi rtags su 'od khyim/ ye shes kyi rtags su thig le/ rig pa sku'i rtags su lu gu rgyud phra ba rta rnga dkyus pa lta bu/ de rnams gnas lugs tsit+ta sha yi sgron ma zhes snying gi dkyil na bum nang gi mar me ltar gnas/ de nyid dkar 'jam rtsa yi sgron ma'i lam las dbang po'i dwangs ma mig la mngon sum du 'char ro// rna ba u ta'i sgra la sems bzung nas rna ba'i mngon shes la sogs pa nas gzhom med kyi sgra yi bar du sgrub thabs thog mar rna ba gnyis ka 'ber gyis bkag nas zhag shas la sgra gzhan mi thos par rna ba nyid kyi rang sgra la sems bzung nas rim gyis slob pa yin cing*/ tshul 'di bla ma dgongs 'dus las rgyas par gsal/ de ltar sgra 'od zer gsum la brten nas bsgoms pas rtags snang gi nyams shar ba kun dus der bla ma la zhus nas rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud sku dang ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od dang thig ler snang ba 'di sku lnga ye shes lnga rigs lnga 'od lnga rlung lnga shes rab lnga sogs rdzogs chen gzhan ltar gang zag so so'i nyams 'char lugs dang bstun nas bla ma nyams myong can gyis rim gyi ngo sprod dgos pa yin gyi/ da lta nas 'di bzhin 'char yong zhes bshad na nyams 'char ba la gnod pas rgyas par ma bshad do// 'on kyang phyogs tsam ni/ rgyang zhag chu yi sgron ma tsak+ṣu'i lam las/ dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma chu 'dzin gyis ma g.yogs pa'i nam mkha' la/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma snang ba'i nang gi rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud gsal ba la bltas pas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes lhag ger skye ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes pa gsal dwangs ka dag dang lhun grub gnyis su med pa de shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma zhes bya la/

de'ang rtsibs shar gyen 'greng la sogs par mthong ba 'di dag /las dang po pa'i rkyen la ltos pa tsam yin gyi/ gzhan 'khrul snang yin pa lta zhog /chos nyid yongs grub bde gshegs snying po'i cha shas mngon sum du man ngag gi gnad zab mo 'di la bsten nas las dang po pas kyang mthong ba yin phyir chos nyid mngon sum zhes bya/ de la rim gyis goms pa na dbyings thig le'i dbus su rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud chub pa'i skabs su dbyings rig dbyer med du rtogs pa ste/ de'ang dang po dbyings rig res gsal/ res mi gsal ba 'byung*/ de nas dbyings rig dbang po dngos dang bral te thig le rnams sran ma tsam du 'char/ 'od lnga'i snang ba dum bur chad de gyen 'greng dang*/ rtsibs shar/ chig rkyang*/ lcags thag lta bu dang*/ lu gu rgyud dang mdung rtse lta bur 'gyur/ thig le yang me long tsam du 'gyur/ de nas dbyings kyi snang ba la 'od kyi drwa ba dang*/ mig mang ris dang*/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i rnam par 'char/ 'od kyang rang gnas pa'i lung pa khengs pa tsam/ thig le yang phub tsam du 'gyur te nyin mtshan khyad med du rtags snang 'char/ thig le'i nang du lha sku rkyang pa dang*/ phyed sku/ zur zhal sogs mthong ba de nyams gong 'phel zhes bya/ 'di tsam na bar do'i snang ba rang sar grol lo// nyams snang des snang srid snod bcud kun la rgyas gdab ste tha mal gyi zhen pa ldog pas nyams kyi rtags snang gong 'phel du song nas thig le'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum tshom bu rang lus dang 'brel bar snang ba ni rig pa tshad phebs zhes bya ste 'di tsam nas ma bsgom yang rang bzhin longs sku'i zhing du grol bar the tshom med do// de lta bu'i nyams kyi snang ba thams cad kyang chos nyid bde gshegs snying po'i rang mdangs gshis kyi rang bzhin du thim pas nyams kyi rnam pa'i yul can gyi snang ba zad nas/ don dam bde gshegs snying po'i rgyal khams su 'bras bu gzhi thog na slebs te nyams kyi 'phel ba zad/

snang nyams dag nas 'dzin pa'i ngo bo med cing*/ 'khrul rtog /grub mtha'/ byas chos thams cad zad pa na chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba zhes tha snyad tsam du btags pa'o// ci yang med pa chad lta lta bu min par mkhyen brtse nus mthu mdzad phrin yon tan brjod mi nus pa mngon du 'gyur zhing*/ zag bcas kyi phung po med par 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i skur grol te nam mkha' ji srid 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'o// skabs 'dir 'di ltar go dgos te/ rig pa dang dbyings snang bzhi po la brtan pa thob kyang*/ sngar rlung sems la sbyor ba dman zhing nye rgyu'i spyod pa sogs ma grub pas snyigs ma rnam smin gyi lus sbyong ma btub na/ tshe 'phos ma thag zung 'jug gi sku phyag chen gyi rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur gyi/ rlung sems la rang dbang ma thob pa rnams kyis tshe 'dir lhag med 'od lus 'grub pa'i bshad pa med do// de bas na 'od lus zag med 'grub par 'dod pa dang*/ gnas skabs su las bzhi grub pa brgyad sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan thob par 'dod pa dag gis rtsa rlung thig le'i nyams len gnad du smin pa shin tu nas kyang gces so// des rdzogs chen gyi snang bzhi tshad du phyin pa yin no// de'ang nang gi rig pa rang tsho thub cing lhun grub kyi snang ba ci ltar shar yang snang stong dbyer med du bsgom pa ma gtogs chos nyid mngon sum gyi skabs su phyi rol gyi thig le thig phran lha sku sogs la zhen cing 'thas na gzugs khams su skye ba'i rten byed pas zhen pa med par ma zad dbyings snang dang las snang bsre zhing bsdu ba sogs gal che ste/ don du rig pa de phyi ru shar ba ltar snang yang nang rgyang zhag chu yi sgron ma zhes mig gi nang du 'char bas phyi don du 'dzin par mi bya'o// rgya nag sprul sku'i dris lan du/ rna ba u ta'i sgra la byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad bcad/

rgyal mo'i 'od mdangs la mthong bya mthong byed gnyis 'dug gam mi 'dug brtags sogs gsungs pa/ sgra 'od zer gsum ka'i rtags snang shin tu brtan pa na/ spros mtha' gcod pa'i phyir de ltar bya dgos pa'i skabs yod pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa tsam yin gyi thog ma'i skabs 'dir rtog med kyi ngang du blo bzhag pa gal che ba ma gtogs 'di lta bu'i dpyad pa mang po mi legs shing*/ mtha' rten sogs rgyas par rdzogs chen gzhan nas kha skong ba ni/ mi 'gul ba gsum gyis gzhi bca' ba zhes dus kun lus bzhugs stangs gsum gang rung la gnas pa ste/ lus mi 'gul bas mig mi 'gul/ mig mi 'gul bas rtsa mi 'gul/ rtsa mi 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/ rlung mi 'gul bas sems mi 'gul/ de nyid kyis 'gyu byed rgyun chad nas rig pa g.yo med du gnas pa'i dgos pa yod do// mig gzigs stangs gsum dang mi 'bral bar bya ste/ chos sku'i gzigs stangs gyen dang*/ longs sku'i zur khrid/ sprul sku'i gzigs stangs thur phabs sam mdung tshugs su nyi ma la bltas pas phyi nang gi dbyings rig mthong ste/ rig pa'i gnad rtsa/ rtsa'i gnad sgo/ sgo'i gnad sgron ma'o// de yang mi 'gul pa gsum gyis rtog tshogs 'byung mi srid cing dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i dgos pa yod do// sdod pa gsum gyi tshad bzung ba ni/ dbyings rig la yun ring bar gnas pas brtan pa'i tshad sdod pa gsum ste/ phyi snang ba skyod byed kyi rlung zad pas dbyings rig 'gro 'ong med par sdod/ nang phung po skyod byed kyi rlung zad pas lus g.yo 'gul med par sdod/ gsang ba rtog pa skyod byed kyi rlung zad pas rtog pa 'gyu mi srid par sdod pa'o// 'di dag tu tshad rmi lam gyis bzung ba dang*/ rtags lus ngag yid gsum la 'char te/ rab rmi lam rgyun chad/ 'bring 'od gsal du 'char/ tha ma la rmi lam rmi lam du ngo shes/

chos nyid mngon sum gyi rtags/ lus rus sbal 'khar gzhong du bcug pa ltar bya byed g.yo 'gul med par gnas/ ngag lkugs pa ltar smra mi 'dod/ sems 'dab chags rnyis zin pa ltar 'phro ba bzhin snang yang gar gtad du zin pa'o// nyams snang gong 'phel gyi rtags/ lus skyes bu nad kyis thebs pa ltar byi dor dang rgyan cha'i sgeg 'chos bral/ ngag smyo ba ltar cal col du smra/ sems skyes bu rtsi dug gis zin pa ltar khams gsum du phyir mi ldog par thag chod do// rig pa tshad phebs kyi rtags/ lus glang chen 'dam du bying ba ltar skad cig ma la 'byung ba lnga la thal byung du 'gro/ ngag grul bum gyi phru gu ltar ci smras gzhan la phan/ sems skyes bu 'brum nad byang ba ltar 'khor bar mi ldog pa'i gdeng thob pa'o// chos nyid zad pa'i rtags/ lus dur khrod kyi ro ltar gshed ma brgyas mtha' bskor yang*/ ya nga bag tsha med/ ngag brag cha ltar gtam gyi zungs zad pas gzhan gyi rjes zlos byed/ sems bar snang gi na bun ltar skad cig ma la bag chags kyi phung po mi snang bar sangs rgya'o// thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa ni/ skye ba la rang dbang thob pas gdos bcas kyi phung po mi snang zhing*/ sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod na/ chu zla lta bur snang ba'i gzugs kyis sems can gyi don byed/ 'jug pa la rang dbang thob pas bem po la rig pa bcug kyang 'gul ba dang skad 'byin par nus/ rlung sems la rang dbang thob pas rlung las su rung ba sogs yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing sems can gzhan tshe 'pho ba'i dus su de la rig pa bcug pas mtshams med lnga spyad pa dag kyang rang dang mnyam du sangs rgyas par nus te/ las la bzang ngan med pa'i gnad kyis so// gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad bstan pa ni/ rang rig las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med par rtogs pas dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan thob tu re ba dang*/ ma thob dogs pa med pa ste yar gyi gdeng gnyis dang*/

rnam rtog dbyings su thim pas 'khor bar ltung mkhan ma grub pas 'gro drug gi tshe tshad sdug bsngal thos kyang ltung gis dogs pa dang*/ mi ltung ba'i re ba med pa mar gyi gdeng gnyis so// de ltar snang bzhi'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs nas gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad tshe 'dir thob pas gdos bcas 'od lus su 'gyur te sangs rgyas pa ni 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'o// de dag gis dbang po rab tshe 'dir grol pa'i gdams pa rgyas par bshad nas/ dbang po 'bring bar dor grol pa'i tshul ni/ skye gnas kyi bar do la ded dpon gser gling du 'gro ba lta bu ste/ dper na rgya mtshor nor bu len pa na bya rog dang dung la sogs pas chu srin yin min gyi sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas 'gro ba ltar bla ma dam pa'i drung du thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas bar do'i 'od gsal la 'jug ste/ de'ang rab kyi tha ma'i dbang du chab rom chur zhu ba ltar gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas rim gyis 'khrul pa rang snang du ngo shes te grol ba'o// 'chi kha'i bar do la rgyal po'i bka' phrin bskur ba brjed na chad pas bcad dogs kyi yid la gsal bzhin/ rang nyid 'khor bar skrag pas gdams pa mi brjed pa ste/ de'ang 'bring gi tha ma'i dbang du khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa ltar lus lci zhing ldang mi thub pa dang mig gyen du ldog pa sogs kyi rtags byung ba dang sngar bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag gang la myong ba thon pa rnams skabs 'dir blo la gsal thebs par bya/ chos nyid kyi bar do la yid ches pa ma pang du bu rgyug pa lta bu'i gdams pa ni dbang po tha ma'i rab rnams bum pa chag pa ltar/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas nang dbugs chad/ rnam shes nam mkha' la thim pas sems dbyings su thim ste dar cig brgyal/ de sangs nas chos sku nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba lta bu zhig 'char ba de nyid ngos zin pa tsam gyis ka dag gi gzhi la rang grol ba'o// de nas rang gi mig gnyis nas 'od kyi zer thag nam mkha'i mthongs su shar ba la rig pa gtad pas zang thal du grol lo// de ngos ma zin na zer thag de las mched pa'i 'od zer dang zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'char te/

de'i tshe snang ba mched pa de rnams ngo shes pas rang shar rang grol du 'gyur te dbang po tha ma'i 'bring gi grol lugs so// shin tu dbang po tha ma'i tha ma ni grol ba'i gdeng ma rnyed pas rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skye'o// srid pa bar do la las bzang po'i 'phro mthud yur ba chad pa la wa 'dzugs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag ni/ de ltar lhun grub kyi snang ba nub nas srid pa'i bar dor rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar dbang po tshang zhing las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i yid lus 'grub ste/ bar dor ci tsam gnas pa'i phyed snga ma'i dang*/ phyed phyi ma gang du skye ba'i lus dang bag chags ldan pa 'char ba/ de'ang lha dang mir skye na 'od dkar po 'dom gang bas brgyan cing mgo bo gyen du bstan/ lha min dang dud 'gror 'od ser po dang mgo bo 'phred du blta/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags 'od nag po dang mgo thur du bstan snyam byed/ skye gnas su 'jug dus lhar skye na lha khang skyed tshal/ lha min la 'od kyi 'khor lo/ mir skye bo mang po 'tshogs pa mthong zhing*/ dud 'gror sa phug dang spyil po/ yi dwags grog stong dang phug rdug /dmyal bar mun nag dang kha char gyis ded pa'i snang ba sogs 'byung ba'i dus/ rab kyi mi'i mngal sogs bden med du shes pa'am zhen log gis bkag nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yid la byed pas khegs/ 'bring gi sgyu ma lta bu'i lha yi 'khyer so gsum la mnyam par bzhag pas yi dam lha'i skur 'gyur bas khegs/ tha mas mngal chos 'byung du bsam pa'i nang du pad+ma nyi ma'i steng na oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs yi dam gyi sa bon gsal btab nas rnam shes de la 'jug cing pha ma yi dam gyi lhar bskyed pa sogs kyis chos la spyod pa'i mi lus thob pa ni mngal gdam pa'o// yang tha rnams ni snang ba de dag shar ba'i dus su bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs 'gro bya zhing smon lam khyad par can btab pas bde 'gror skye bar 'gyur ro// 'di dag ni chos nyid mngon sum gyi don ma mthong bar tshe'i dus byas pa rnams kyi dbang du byas te/

de'ang da lta nas lha bsgom sngags bzla sogs dang*/ tha mal gyi za 'chag nyal 'dug ci byed thams cad bar dor bsam zhing gdams ngag rnams goms shing 'dris par sbyangs bas dgos don 'grub bo// brtson 'grus tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste bar do med par grol ba'i tshul ni/ tshe 'dir chos nyid mngon sum gyi don mthong yang bsgom long ma byung bas/ bar do'i grol tshad dang mi ldan pa rnams chos nyid kyi bar do shar yang ngos ma zin te/ srid pa'i bar do rmi lam gyi cha tsam du snang ba las chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon pad+mā ka ra'i thugs rjes rmi lam sad pa'i cha tsam la pad+ma 'od la sogs par rang snang dag pa rigs lnga'i zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams su brdzus te skye zhing o rgyan rdo rje 'chang sogs bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhal mthong gdams pa nod pas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba kun las grol nas mthar thug steng gi nam mkha' mi mjed brtsegs par dur khrod me ri 'bar ba khro bo'i zhing khams mthong ste gdod ma'i gzhi la skad cig de nyid la grol nas nang gsal sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can gang la gang 'dul gyi skur mngon par snang bas 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ltar 'gro ba'i yid dang mthun par snang zhing mthar thug gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god par mdzad do// de dag ni rdzogs chen dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi bka' 'grel ri rgyal lhun por/ bar do ni: ye nas stong pa nam mkha' lta bu dang: gting nas stong pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang: gsal la stong pa nyi ma lta bu dang:

kun kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i gsal stong bsgom: zhes gsungs pa'i don cung zad bkral ba'o// de ltar sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang bcas pas thod rgal gyi lam lhun grub ye shes yid dpyod du ma lus par chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i khrid dang lam gyi yan lag bar do lam khyer gyi rim pa dang bcas bshad zin to/ ༈ /de nas le'u brgyad pa'i don 'pho ba ni/ gzhung rtsa bar/ 'pho ba skar khung mda' 'phang ni: 'od kyi gong bu sgra yis 'pho: yang yang sbyangs pas rtags myur thon: ces dang*/ rgya nag sprul sku'i dris lan du/ 'pho ba yang dbang po rab la 'pho bya 'pho byed med par rang sems ma bcos lhug pa ni chos sku'i 'pho ba'o zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon du gyur na thabs tshul gzhan la mi ltos shing*/ 'bring la yi dam lha'i bskyed rim dang rlung sems dmigs pa la brten nas 'pho ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don lag len du ston pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad legs par bcas nas pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bskyed rim gsal dwangs rnyog pa med pa snang zhing stong*/ stong zhing gsal ba chu zla lta bur bsgom pa'i sku'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam kha dog dkar zhing gsal la dwangs ba/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir slebs pa/ smyug tshig bzhin rang 'gags su song ba/ yar sna spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar thon pa/ snying gar rang gi rnam par shes pa rdo rje dkar po 'od lhag ge ba gcig dbu ma'i nang dbus su gsal btab/ spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la/ ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol zhing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'od zer byung bas dbu ma'i yar sna rgya mthongs phyes pa ltar gyur pa'i nang nas brgyud de snying ga'i rdo rje la zug par bsgoms la 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs bya ste/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// zab lam 'pho bas mkha' la spyod pa dang*// rnam shes dbu ma'i sbubs nas thon gyur te// bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs// zab lam

sogs 'gre'o// sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar ma la= /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la= /gter ston brgya dang rtsa brgyad la= /gar dbang 'ja' tshon snying po la= /bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje la= /gter chen klong gsal snying po la= /pad+ma bde chen gling pa la= /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la= /bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta la= /rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po la= /drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// sogs brjod la/ de nas rlung gnad sngar gtum mo'i skabs bzhin dal bus rngub/ lte 'og tu mer gyis bkang*/ slar yang khong pa'i nang nas steng rlung gnon chung byas te gzhil/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then nas kha sbyor du bzung*/ sems snying ga'i rdo rje la rtse gcig tu gtad rlung mi thub pa snyam na rngub chung brtsegs te gzhil/ btang ba'i skabs su hika ces bla ma'i thugs kar sems gtad/ phaṭa ces pas snying ga'i rdo rje de rtsal chen gyis mda' 'phangs pa'i shugs ltar dbu ma'i nang nas 'ja' 'od kyi lam brgyud de bla ma snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la thal byung sgrib thogs med par song nas thugs kar slebs par mos/ sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas rlung phyi 'dzin cung zad bya/ yang rlung rngub pa'i skabs rdo rje de sngar gyi gnas nas rim par phab ste snying gar gnas pa la sems gtad/ ka zhes rlung sngar bzhin 'dzin/ dbyung ba na rlung gnad sgra gdangs dmigs pa bcas sngar bzhin byas/ rdo rje de bla ma snang mtha'i thugs kar slebs cing*/ rlung phyir 'dzin skabs der mthar thug gi don du 'pho bya 'pho byed 'pho ba'i yul ma grub pa'i mtshon byed rtog med kyi ngang du cung zad re 'jog /de lta bu nan tan du bsgom zhing*/ mthar thun 'jog pa'i tshe dge ba bsngo'o// rlung dang sbrags pa'i 'pho ba 'di gzhan las rtags myur ba'i phyir/ spyi bo skrangs pa/

'phrigs pa dang*/ chu ser thon pa sogs 'ong bas de bar du nan gyis bsgom/ rlung dang sbrags tshe hika dang phaṭa ces yid kyis bsam pa las brjod mi bde yang rlung dang mi sbrags na yar sngar dus hika phaṭa dang mar dbab dus ka zhes brjod/ yang la la zhig tshangs bug med pa'i don gyis sbyangs skabs su mgo bo na ba dang*/ klad yu 'khor ba 'ong rigs kyang yod pas gegs sel du spyi bo'i bla ma mtho bar btegs nas tshangs bug cher langs pa nas rnam shes thon par bsgoms pas sel zhing*/ 'byongs ches pas tshe la gzan gras byung na dmigs pa 'og tu gtad pa dang tshe bsnyen sogs bya'o// de nas las la sbyor ba'i dus ni 'chi ltas ldog tu med pa shar pa'i skabs su yin gyi dus min du nyes par 'gyur bas mi bya/ rtags thon nas kyang ma brjed tsam re ma byas na dgos pa'i skabs su 'pho mi btub pas nyams len nar mar bya/ ha cang thal drags na tshe la gzan pas tshod 'dzin/ las la spyod dus rlung kum bha ka la rang dbang thob na dka' tshegs med kyang gal te rtsol ba zhan pas lan gcig gis 'pho ma nus na'ang lan kha shas bskyar bas 'pho'o// 'phos nas mar mi dbab par bla ma snang ba mtha' yas de nyid thog mar dpag tshad tsam dang*/ de nas steng phyogs kyi lha gnas thams cad las brgal te 'og min gyi zhing khams sam/ bde ba can du gshegs par mos/ gzhan la 'debs dus rang nyid lhar gsal zhing*/ khyad par sngar sbyangs pa'i skabs ci lta bar tshe 'das kyi phung por stong ra dbu ma rnam shes kyi rten dang spyi bo'i bla ma bsgoms nas gsol 'debs byas la/ ka hika phaṭa ces brjod pas ka zhes tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i rnam shes la sems gtad/ hika ces dbu ma'i lam las snang mtha' thugs kar bstim/ phaṭa ces pas bde ba can du spar ro// de ltar skra nas 'then cing rtags ma thon bar gsol 'debs dang dmigs pa bskyar mthar bsngo smon bya/ shi nas zhag grangs song ba la ni phung por rnam shes bkug nas 'debs par bshad kyang lus las rnam shes thon tshar nas 'pho ba btab pa don med pas ngan song sbyang thabs gzhan la 'bad par bya'o// rang nyid kyang 'chi khar dngos su 'pho ma nus kyang dmigs pa rnams bsgoms na phan yon shin tu che'o// 'og min gyi gnas zhes pa spyir ni chos kyi dbyings gcig pu gdul bya'i dpal du rnam pa thams cad pra phab lta bur bshad pas sku dang zhing khams gcig tu ngos bzung byar med kyang*/

'og min chen po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku stug po bkod pa na bzhugs par bshad pa'i gnas de yin zhing*/ rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i zhing la phal chen las rgya tshad sogs ches che bar gsungs pas 'og min 'bring po dang*/ chung ngu ni gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min zhes pa der 'dod dgos shing*/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas chung du tsā ri sogs kyi steng gi cha dang*/ chen po ni o rgyan la sogs par sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams 'dod gzugs kyi lus rten can gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i gnas de dag go// dbang po tha ma ni/ rang gar skye 'dod pa'i gnas la dmigs te dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bsngo zhing smon lam shugs drag po btab pas de ru skye nus pa'o// yang tha rdzas kyi 'pho ba'ang sgo khyad par can du rlung sems don nus ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rgya mgron sbrum ma bsregs thal dang*/ sbrang rgod/ rdo khab len/ rgya tshwa/ lce tsha'i me tog sbyar nas spyi bor byugs par gter gzhung nas gsungs kyang lag len gyi srol med do// yun ni dbang po rab la zhag gcig /'bring gsum/ tha mas bdun gyis 'byongs nges shing*/ des kyang ma 'byongs na rang gis gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla ma dang dam tshig 'gal na 'pho ba dang lha bsgom sngags bzlas sogs kyi re ltos byas kyang phan pa gtan nas med par mar gyi zang thal nyid du gsungs shing*/ de ltar ma yin par tshe 'dir so thar gyi sdom pa nyams pa tsam dang*/ sdig pa chen po byas sam/ sngon gyi las sgrib tshan che ba yin na rdor sems bsgom bzlas tshogs bskang la sogs bshags sbyang la 'bad cing*/ slar yang nyams len gnyug bsrings pas dgos don 'grub bo// des ni 'pho ba lam gyi skyel ma'i dmigs khrid bshad zin to/ ༈ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa chen po spyi dang bye brag gi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ gdams pa'i babs lugs sogs dang thun mong gi sngon 'gro/

gegs sel bogs 'don la sogs pa'i skor rnams rgyas par gzhan du shes shing*/ mdor bsdus bka' 'grel dang nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la gu ru rin po che nyid kyis gdams par mdzad pa'i zhus lan sogs la gzigs nas khong du chud par bya'o// de nas rdzogs pa chen po 'chad cing spel ba'i rig 'dzin gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bka' rtsis kyi rgyas gdab pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ e ma ho: dkon mchog spyi 'dus dam chos yang snying 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus: theg pa'i yang rtse rtsol med a ti che: rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sems can 'dren pa'i chos: ma 'ongs rtsub 'gyur bzhi bcu'i dus kyi tshe: 'gro ba phal cher chos min las la spyod: lha mi skye 'gro mtha' dbus 'khrugs pa'i dus: las can sbyangs pa can dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'brel tshad thar lam 'dren gyur cig: mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyis skyongs shig: mtsho sman klu bdud gnyis kyis srungs shig: ces ye shes kyi ḍā ki dang 'jig rten gyi srung mar gnyer du gtad phyir rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du rung bar mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung ba'i bu la gcig brgyud du gdams shing*/ des kyang mngon zhen le lo spangs nas tshul bzhin nyams su len dgos so// de'ang chos 'di la sngon sbyangs dang mi ldan par stes dbang gis 'phrad par mi 'gyur te/ gter gzhung nyid las/ lung zin skyes bu rnams las mang du 'phel: tshe gcig grub thob sum cu rtsa brgyad 'byung: phyir mi ldog pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'byung: lam sna zin pa stong dang khri phrag lngaḥ 'brel thogs bye ba gsum dang 'bum phrag 'byung: de nas ma gcig ḍā ki seng ha yis: bod yul 'di na chos 'di'i dpe mi bzhag: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i zhing du gdan drangs so: zhes dang*/ khyad par nga yi gter chos zab mo dang: 'phrad dang 'brel tshad sbyangs pa sngon song yin:

di phyir las sad skyes bu ma gtogs pa: rtog ge tha snyad mkhan dang tshig phyir 'brang: bsags med phal pa'i 'gro bas mos mi 'gyur: de phyir nga yi gter chos su mos pa: nyams su sus blangs tshe gcig mi grol re: khyad par thugs sgrub kun gyi snying po ni: yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus man ngag 'di: chos nyid don rdzogs 'dus pa'i yang snying yin: rang gi sgrub thabs rang gis mdzad pa'o: las can ma gtogs gzhan la spel mi rung: zhes bslu med rdo rje'i bka' yis ched du brjod phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar dkon zhing ngo mtshar ches che ba'i zab mo'i gdams par yid ches pas brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su blangs nas rang gzhan 'brel thogs thams cad zhing khams gcig tu thugs yid 'dres pa'i 'od gong khyab brdal lhun grub tu sangs rgyas shing don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad 'tshal/ smras pa/ gsang chen zab rgur mchog gi dngos grub nyid// mngon du byed la bla mar rag las tshul// bshad mod thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'dzam gling gi /sngags kyi ston mchog gu ru rje de yi// sgrub thabs dngos grub mchog gi nye lam gang*// mang yang dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs// mtha' klas spyi yi don 'das sgrub thabs phul// 'di ni mdo sngags kun gyi snying por nges// lha sngags ting 'dzin gsum po dbyer med pa// lam dus mngon rtogs rgyud la sbyor ba'i tshul// 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhad rtsal// gang de'i gsung gsang gu ru'i dgongs rgyan zhes// don 'grel pad+ma dkar po'i tshal chen der// lhag bsam nyin mor byed pa'i dbang po yis// nye bar rtsen mthus phyin ci ma log pa'i// legs bshad sbrang rtsi skal bzang bcud du smin// rab 'byams las la dbang byed bskyed rim dang*// mchog dngos bde blag thob byed rdzogs rim zhes// zung 'jug lam nyid sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags// de phyir 'bad pas lam srol gsal bar phyes// zab mo'i gnad la rtog ge'i 'ol tshod kyi// 'dom gyis gzhal bas don la 'gongs nas slar// legs par bshad rlom don bral yi ge'i tshogs// 'ga' dang 'di nyid mtshungs sam brtag cing dpyod// dge des rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad 'byung gi

/ring lugs srid pa'i mthar yang nyams med cing*// 'gro rnams theg chen zab mo'i lam mchog la// brten nas rnam grol 'bras bu thob phyir bsngo// zhes yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po'i rdzogs rim bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// des ni khrid kyi rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no// tshul 'di ni yongs 'dzin sku zhabs mchog dang*/ skyabs rje 'brug pa rin po che'i zhabs 'bring pa dad dam phun tshogs bslab gsum rgyan ldan lde 'chang mi pham bka' brgyud dpal ldan gyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor gter gzhung dang*/ yang 'grel sogs rdo rje'i gsung rnams khrigs su bsdebs par rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung man ngag gis brgyan cing 'jug bder 7si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du bkod pa dge/ dge'o// dge'o/// /
